deployments_detail.use: "EndoBRAIN" + "Olysense" CAD/AI endoscopic image diagnostic support (EVIS X1 integration; CE-marked via Odin Medical)

ENDO-AID CADe: real-time AI computer-aided detection application running on the ENDO-AID platform (OIP-1) with the EVIS X1 endoscopy system, using a neural-network algorithm to flag suspected colorectal polyps/lesions during colonoscopy and increase adenoma detection rate. [Olympus (in-house)]

CADDIE (OLYSENSE platform): cloud-based AI device for colonoscopy that detects and characterizes colorectal polyps; FDA 510(k) cleared (July 2024) for detection in the US and CE-marked in Europe, commercially launched in US and Europe. [Olympus / Odin Vision (cloud-AI)]

CADU (OLYSENSE platform): cloud-based AI application that analyzes dysplasia in Barrett's Esophagus patients during upper-GI endoscopy; CE-marked and launched in Europe. [Olympus / Odin Vision (cloud-AI)]

SMARTIBD (OLYSENSE platform): cloud-based AI application that analyzes ulcerative colitis severity using the MAYO endoscopic scoring system; CE-marked and launched in Europe as part of the OLYSENSE CAD/AI intelligent endoscopy ecosystem. [Olympus / Odin Vision (cloud-AI)]

Acquisition of Odin Vision, a London/UCL cloud-AI endoscopy company, to build Olympus' cloud-AI endoscopy capability and Digital Excellence Centers; Odin's CADDIE/CADU/SMARTIBD apps became the core of Olympus' intelligent endoscopy ecosystem. [Odin Vision (acquired by Olympus)]

AI-powered surgical planning / clinical decision tool via strategic partnership with Ziosoft (Ziosoft Revoras platform): translates CT/MRI images into dynamic real-time 3D models using AI for pre-operative planning in thoracic, liver, and urologic surgery. [Ziosoft (Revoras platform)]

cellSens imaging software TruAI deep-learning technology for life-science microscopy: trained neural networks perform label-free nucleus detection and improved segmentation/analysis on low signal-to-noise microscopy images. [Olympus (in-house TruAI)]

OLYMPUS Stream industrial microscope image-analysis software (v2.5) TruAI deep-learning module: lets users train neural networks to automatically segment and classify features for industrial material inspection, metallography, semiconductor QC and mineralogy. [Olympus / Evident (in-house TruAI)]

Partnership with DIGESTAID to co-develop and deploy AI-powered Software-as-a-Medical-Device (SaMD) solutions for the hepato-pancreato-biliary (HPB) field, extending the OLYSENSE intelligent endoscopy ecosystem. [DIGESTAID]

AI research & development infrastructure: Olympus runs its AI/ML image-data development environment on Everpure AIRI with Red Hat OpenShift containers and Pure Storage FlashBlade, enabling faster provisioning and go-to-market for new AI endoscopy solutions. [Everpure (AIRI), Red Hat OpenShift, Pure Storage FlashBlade]
